generations.name: First generation (77.4 kWh)
generations.notes: E-GMP 800 V electric GV70: 77.4 kWh pack, rated for 350 kW DC chargers (10-80 % in 18 min claimed). NRCan from 2023, EPA from 2024. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Genesis_GV70

generations.name: 2026 facelift (84 kWh)
generations.notes: Refresh unveiled November 2024, in US showrooms early 2025 as a 2026 model, with an 84 kWh pack (both regulators show higher 2026 ranges). EPA base model "GV70" is safe because the EPA import is BEV-only. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Genesis_GV70
